headline: Start Aaron Jones over Quinshon Judkins in your FLEX before Sunday's 10:00 AM PT kickoffs — Jordan Mason's move to IR hands Jones the Vikings backfield.
summary: Danny is 1-0 and the roster is mostly right; the one real correction is Jones for Judkins in FLEX given Judkins' brutal Tampa Bay spot and shared passing-down work. Burrow (back) and Juwan Johnson (illness) were both limited again Thursday but each is trending toward playing Sunday, so keep Willis ready as Burrow's auto-sub insurance.

lineup.why: Jordan Mason went to IR (thumb fracture, out 4+ weeks), handing Jones the Vikings' early-down and passing-down work in a much better game (implied 22 vs Judkins' 16.5).
lineup.evidence: Sept 17: Mason placed on IR, Vikings signed DeeJay Dallas as depth but Jones is the clear lead with a projected 60% snap share in a 48.5-point Sun 10:00 AM game vs CHI (implied 22). Judkins remains Cleveland's carry leader but keeps ceding third-down/passing work to Raheim Sanders (15 routes to 13 last week) in a 41.5-point game at Tampa Bay with only a 16.5 implied total (underdog by 8.5).
